summary: The diff implements most core requirements but lacks evidence of user name display throughout the UI. Backend stores names in UserProfile and enables role-based doubt/answer posting with attachments. However, the frontend file summaries and truncated code do not show names being displayed in doubt cards, answer cards, header, or leaderboard as required by REQ-4.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display user names in doubt cards, answer cards, and throughout the application UI
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend file summaries describe DoubtCard and AnswerCard components but do not mention displaying author/responder names. Summary states 'author, timestamp, description' for DoubtCard and 'responder, text, rating stars' for AnswerCard without explicitly including name display. Layout component mentions 'user profile display' but unclear if this shows the name. No evidence of names on leaderboard despite LeaderboardTable being described.

hallucinated_features.description: Rating system for answers with star ratings and user rating input
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff includes RatingStars.tsx, RatingInput.tsx, useRateAnswer hook, and rating functionality in AnswerCard. The BuildRequest explicitly excludes rating features in non-goals and does not mention rating in any requirement or acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Leaderboard system with points tracking for seniors
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff includes LeaderboardPage, LeaderboardTable, useGetLeaderboard hook, and backend seniorPoints Map. The BuildRequest does not request a leaderboard feature, points system, or ranking mechanism. While REQ-4 mentions 'Names are displayed on the leaderboard', this appears to be an acceptance criterion assuming a leaderboard exists, but no requirement requests creating one.
